## Appearance

Rilla Blythe is characterized by her hazel eyes and striking hair, which features long, ruddy, curly red locks. When styled, her hair forms sleek and round curls.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## History

As a six-year-old child, Rilla Blythe lived at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) under the care of her mother, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md). On one occasion, while trying to deliver a basket of strawberries to the manse, she was frightened and chased down the street by [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) brandishing a dried codfish. Miss Cornelia rescued the terrified, muddy child and brought her safely back home.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P9](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--rilla-blythe.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Rilla's mother. As a small child growing up at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), Rilla lives under Anne's care alongside the rest of the family and servants. [Anne](../character/anne.md) comforts and protects Rilla when the young girl runs into trouble in the neighborhood, such as when she returns home terrified and muddy after being chased by [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md).

- Child of — mother  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>
